comment: T1-T3 source trust for scenario records (contract T1-T3; owner question Q4). The evidence builder assigns trust from this table by each event's `src`, never from the record's own content. A source not listed fails that run rather than defaulting to independent. Harness and Component 4 sources added 6 Oct (owner): the agent's trace is actor-written; gateway, tracer and validator are co-located until a privileged read-only observer exists. A user's own terminal recording (user-terminal, 7 Oct) is actor-written.

sacct-controller.why: slurmdbd accounting read in the controller pod; no actor has a session or job there

observer.why: the raw observation pulled from mgmt-git01 through the forced-command observer

monitor-history.why: the off-node monitor's history on mgmt-git01

gitlab.why: GitLab issues and notes on mgmt-git01

lease-file.why: the cluster lease record on the login host, outside the login pod

recovery-points.why: recovery-point records written by the operator's capture tool

sshd-login-pod.why: the login pod's sshd log: actors have shells in that pod

journald-worker.why: journald on a worker where the actor ran a job

k3s-events-worker.why: K3s events emitted by the kubelet of a worker where the actor ran a job

home-files.why: files under /home written by the actor

user-terminal.why: the user's own terminal recording (script(1) on the user's side): what the user typed and saw, the user's account of the session (7 Oct)

agent-trace.why: the agent harness's own projection of its model and tool spans (digests and action IDs only): the agent's account of what it did, never evidence by itself

harness-run.why: the harness run record (attempt boundaries, the declared fixture correction), written by the process that drives the agent

c4-gateway.why: Component 4's action gateway: each request it executed and its exit status; it runs beside the agent and acts with the actor's identity

c4-cluster-tracer.why: Component 4's post-action layout snapshot; on PRACE it runs as syn-tracer inside the login pod where actors have shells (in a local rehearsal, on the harness host)

c4-validator.why: Component 4's validator observations and verdicts: independent of the agent's claims, but read through the same host or pod as the actor until a privileged read-only observer exists
